chapter.title: Applied Energistics
subtitle: One terminal that holds and sorts everything you own.
Certus quartz, four stamped presses, then a network.

quests.title: Mine Eight Certus Quartz Crystals
quests.subtitle: Pale blue clusters in overworld stone.
description: Certus quartz grows in small blue buds in ordinary stone, most often near caves and water.
Every part of this chapter is built from it, so take more than eight.

quests.title: Smelt Eight Silicon
quests.subtitle: Grind certus to dust, then cook the dust.
description: Put certus quartz through a Millstone or a Pulverizer for dust, then smelt the dust into silicon.
Silicon is the base of every processor you are about to print.

quests.title: Build a Charger and Give It Power
quests.subtitle: It turns certus into charged certus.
description: The Charger takes any FE from a Thermal duct. Drop a crystal on its face and wait.
Charged certus is the ingredient nothing else can substitute.

quests.title: Charge Eight Certus Crystals
quests.subtitle: One at a time, on the charger's face.
description: Right-click crystals onto the Charger, or drop a hopper above it and let it work while you do something else.
Eight is enough for the fluix you need.

quests.title: Grow Sixteen Fluix Crystals
quests.subtitle: Throw the three ingredients into water.
description: Drop charged certus, redstone and nether quartz into a pool of water and they fuse on their own.
Fluix is in every cable, every cell and the controller.

quests.title: Build an Inscriber
quests.subtitle: It stamps circuits, one press at a time.
description: The Inscriber takes a press on top, a press underneath and material in the middle.
It does nothing until you have the presses, and those are not crafted.

quests.title: Find the Four Inscriber Presses
quests.subtitle: They only come out of meteorites.
description: Hold the Meteorite Compass and walk until it points down, then dig. The sky stone chest under the crater holds one press each.
Four craters, four presses.

quests.title: Print Eight of Each Processor
quests.subtitle: Print, then press the print onto redstone.
description: Each processor is two passes: stamp the printed circuit and the printed silicon, then inscribe them together with redstone.
A belt into the inscriber does this for you.

quests.title: Build an ME Controller
quests.subtitle: One block. Everything hangs off it.
description: The Controller is the middle of the network. Cables run out of its faces and every device on those cables joins one system.
One is plenty for a first build.

quests.title: Feed the Network Power
quests.subtitle: An acceptor turns FE into AE.
description: Put an Energy Acceptor on the network and run a Thermal energy duct into it. An Energy Cell beside it covers the spikes.
A network with no power stores nothing.

quests.title: Build an ME Drive and a 1k Cell
quests.subtitle: One drive holds ten cells.
description: The Drive is the shelf; the cells are the disks. Slot a 1k Storage Cell in and the network has somewhere to put things.
Cells can be pulled out and carried.

quests.title: Hang an ME Terminal on the Cable
quests.subtitle: Search, sort and pull from one screen.
description: Put the Terminal on the side of a cable and open it. Everything in every cell shows up in one searchable list.
The Crafting Terminal is the same thing with a 3x3 grid.

quests.title: Build a Crafting CPU
quests.subtitle: Four units, a storage and an assembler.
description: Stack Crafting Units, one 1k Crafting Storage and a Molecular Assembler into a solid block group touching the network.
That group is what runs auto-crafting jobs.

quests.title: Set a Pattern Provider on a Machine
quests.subtitle: It pushes ingredients where they go.
description: Encode a recipe at the Pattern Encoding Terminal, put the pattern in a Pattern Provider, and stick the provider against a machine.
Ask the terminal for the result and it builds itself.

rewards.title: The network is running
rewards.description: Next: The Reactor. Uranium, graphite, and twenty-two casings for a box three blocks on a side.
